INSIGHT: Contrary to Tauri docs and common wisdom, pure Rust + most C deps cross-compile fine from macOS to Windows x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.

WHAT WORKS: cargo xwin check validates all Rust + C compilation (ring, opus, cpal, tokio, whisper.cpp without Metal)
WHAT DOESN'T: whisper-rs Vulkan feature needs actual Vulkan SDK installed (expected — use on Windows build machine only)

SETUP:
```bash
cargo install cargo-xwin
brew install llvm ninja
# CFLAGS=-U__ARM_FEATURE_MATMUL_INT8 needed for ARM CI runners
```
USAGE: `cargo xwin check --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`

NOTE: Full `npm run tauri build` still requires Windows (WebView2 bundler, NSIS installer). But cargo check/test for Rust logic works from Mac.
